Complete file and reference index

Diagrams, presentations, video guides, and narration

This is the complete index of the finished results from the diagram and video experiments. Open HTML files in a browser; video players link to their downloadable MP4 files. Finished media is included in this repository. Raw production assets remain local. Skill and package repository links appear beside the collections that used them; local production scripts are in tools/.

Start with the editorial architecture atlas, the original technical architecture video, or the parent and fencer guide with Qwen narration.

Architecture videos

Skills: the two editorial editions use Diagram Design for their diagrams and style; the dark 3b1b edition uses Answer Me with HTML and its bundled video renderer. The editorial editions use our local presentation scripts, Playwright for Python for slide capture, and FFmpeg for video assembly. Their original speech uses the ElevenLabs API, including the recovered narration in the pre-STE rebuild.

EditionLengthWatchVideoScriptCaptions
Original pre-ASD-STE100 narration, editorial diagrams10:14Chapter player · PresentationMP4Narration · Original scriptSRT
STE-inspired narration, editorial diagrams8:02Chapter player · PresentationMP4NarrationSRT
STE-inspired narration, dark 3b1b presentation9:08Narrated presentationMP4Narration · Authoring sourceSRT

The original pre-STE dark video was previously overwritten. Its narration was recovered for the editorial edition above. These are historical explanations of the app at their recorded source revisions; current decisions are in ARCHITECTURE.md (original local source).

Production notes: original editorial, STE editorial, dark presentation. Standalone narration: original editorial WAV, STE editorial WAV.

Parent and fencer instruction videos

Style comes from Diagram Design. These walkthroughs use our local tutorial scripts, Xcode Simulator recordings, Playwright for Python for slide capture, and FFmpeg for timing, magnification, highlights, transitions, and export. The Qwen edition uses MLX Audio with Qwen3-TTS speech and the Qwen3 ForcedAligner model for transcript timing. The first and paced editions use the ElevenLabs API.

Local Qwen narration experiments

Repositories: Qwen3-TTS provides the speech model; MLX Audio provides the local speech server and generation tools on Apple MLX. Both voice experiments use the 0.6B CustomVoice 8-bit MLX model. FFmpeg creates the MP3 exports. See the local speech tools and locked package versions to reuse this setup.

Reference and production files

  • Production function declaration index.
  • Original codebase analysis and review findings.
  • Graphviz quality report.
  • Generation and verification tools.
  • Organization manifest and preserved-file hashes.

Finished results stay in the named folders above. Python, JavaScript, the simulator capture harness, and dependency lists now live in figures/tools/. Reusable simulator recordings, demo inputs, fonts, backgrounds, and title images live in figures/tools/assets/. Temporary renders and logs belong in .runtime/figures/. The downloaded Qwen models and their Python environment live in .runtime/qwen-tts/.

The October 2026 cleanup removed render caches, intermediate frames, rehearsal logs, copied build projects, Python bytecode, and Finder metadata. It preserved finished videos, narration, diagrams, source captures, and downloaded models. Validation reports describe the original production checks; frame-comparison checks require rendering fresh intermediate frames first.

Preview images and fonts are embedded. This catalog opens offline. Result links use files in this workspace; large video and audio files are kept locally.

Video images are frames from the finished exports. Audio images show actual waveforms. Canvas and document images are labeled browser renderings of their source files.
